title: Sustained execution of 20 top-level stand-in tasks at a 100 user / 1000 application profile, and the capacity it measures

scope_assessment.measured_workload: historical debugDraft workload; 1000 application/draft rows do not prove 1000 published applications

profile.applications_via: public REST: POST /api/v1/admin/users + POST /api/v1/auth/activate + POST /api/v1/applications + PUT /api/v1/applications/{id}/draft

db_truth.note: user_principals includes the bootstrap admin (100 invited users + admin)

capacity_knob.statement: UPDATE platform.quota_counters SET capacity = 20 WHERE scope = 'global' AND dimension = 'execution_slots'; UPDATE platform.quota_counters SET capacity = 8 WHERE scope = 'global' AND dimension = 'child_slots'
capacity_knob.knob: platform.quota_counters (deployment configuration; no migration, no contract change)

service_time.knob: ORCHARA_CAPACITY_STUB_SERVICE_DELAY (capacity-stub profile only, stub provider only)

concurrency.sweep_note: independent truth: every live attempt interval is swept; the peak is the maximum number of attempts that were live at the same instant. The authoritative capacity is platform.quota_counters.used, which is capped by the claim transaction; a 1-attempt peak excess is reported with its participants instead of being hidden.

inputs.note: the capacity Run is the T086 single-generation model graph executed by the real Go presetexec; one stand-in model call per top-level Run

cancel.note: cancel_requested_at is the server clock of the persisted intent; finished_at is the stop the product actually committed. The API response time is client-measured and reported per row. A Run left in cancelling with a live attempt is reported as stuck, never counted as stopped.

failures.error: the failed proposal was refused: internal API 409 run_state_conflict: the run is not executing; waiting/finalizing/cancelling/reconciliation permit only heartbeat, exit and receipt/query calls
the failed proposal was refused: internal API 409 run_state_conflict: the run is not executing; waiting/finalizing/cancelling/reconciliation permit only heartbeat, exit and receipt/query calls

not_run: GPU utilisation (no GPU on the host)
network throughput of the loopback API (not measured by this harness)
real vendor model latency/cost (stub profile; no vendor endpoint or credential)

environment.models: deterministic stub provider (no vendor endpoint or credential)
environment.sandbox: WSL2/runsc is available but the stand-in graph executes no python node: only the model node and the call_app child run

sweep_report.note: a parked run keeps its held job and its execution slot; no requeue, token swap or second executor happens here. Re-queueing requires cmd/admin runs recover with audited operator evidence.

lease_expiry.slot_policy: documented T038: the parked Run keeps its slot allocated

findings.observed: 2 cancelled Run(s) stayed in cancelling with a live attempt after the 30s stop timeout; finished_at never committed
findings.mechanism: cancel intent lands while the model capability call is in flight; the post-call execution-bearing artifact/result call is refused with 409 run_state_conflict, the worker's failed proposal is refused for the same reason, and the worker returns without confirming its exit
findings.impact: the execution slot stays allocated and the Run never commits a stop
findings.owner: F03/T036 cancel arbitration + F04B worker failure path (not T114)

notes.trials: three independent databases; each profile is seeded from the public endpoints and each trial is 15 minutes of sustained saturation
notes.duration: 45 minutes of measurement plus per-trial profile seeding
